question: Which part of soil has organic materials incorporated with the mineral matter, nutrients and water?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Horizon A**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Horizon A part of soil has organic materials incorporated with the mineral matter, nutrients and water**__.
 
• Soil horizons are layers parallel to the soil surface whose physical, chemical and biological characteristics differ from the layers above and beneath.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• There are commonly 5 layers or horizons found in the soil. **They are known as O, A, B, C & R horizons.**

 
 
• O Horizon Soi:l It contains a huge amount of organic matter.
 
• A Horizon Soil: It is a leached mineral horizon (dark in color) with a high content of organic matter. This horizon is also called ‘Topsoil’.
 
• B Horizon Soil: This horizon is a zone of accumulation of fine materials and mineral Precipitates like clay, iron, carbonates, gypsum, etc. This horizon is also called ‘Subsoil’.
 
• C Horizon Soil: This horizon contains rock fragments of different sizes (partly weathered rocks).
 
• R Horizon Soil: This layer is composed of hard bedrock (unaltered rock layer).
